facts.says: Google Play genre EDUCATION; title Khan Academy Kids; summary: No ads, no subscriptions — ever. Reading, math & phonics for kids ages 2–8.
Khan Academy is an American educational nonprofit organization founded in 2008 by Sal Khan. The organization provides free online learning resources for students and teachers worldwide.

judges.reason: The app provides free online educational learning resources for children.
The app is provided by an educational organization and focuses on learning resources such as reading, math, and phonics for children.
